name: Cristóbal (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered white and yellow, charged with four black wolves' heads and at the centre the crowned municipal arms of Cristóbal (a tree on white and a bend on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Cristóbal; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: four wolves' heads, one in each quarter
Cristóbal arms — tree on white and bend on yellow
